description: This file defines the interface 'NotesRepository' which declares methods for observing, creating, updating, deleting, and synchronizing notes within the application. It includes suspend functions for asynchronous operations and observable streams for real-time updates.

methods.name: observeNotes
methods.description: Returns a flow that emits lists of notes matching the given query, enabling real-time updates.

methods.name: observeNote
methods.description: Returns a flow that emits updates for a specific note identified by its id.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note with the given title and content, returning its assigned id.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with the new title and content.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the note identified by the provided id.

methods.name: syncNow
methods.description: Performs a low-level synchronization operation, typically used by background workers.

methods.name: triggerManualSync
methods.description: Initiates a manual synchronization process, updating sync status observable for the UI.

methods.name: observeSyncStatus
methods.description: Provides an observable stream of the synchronization status for UI components.
